description_en: Binds a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance to the application
name: BindSlb

parameters.help_zh:
绑定公网SLB。例如：[{"port":80,"targetPort":8080,"protocol":"TCP"}]，表示通过TCP协议，将容器的8080端口通过SLB的80端口暴露服务。取值说明如下：

port：SLB端口。
targetPort：容器端口。
protocol：网络协议。支持TCP、HTTP和HTTPS。
httpsCertId：SSL证书。仅限选择HTTPS时需配置SSL证书
parameters.name: internet

parameters.help_zh:
绑定私网SLB。例如：[{"port":80,"targetPort":8080,"protocol":"TCP"}]，表示通过TCP协议，将容器的8080端口通过SLB的80端口暴露服务。取值说明如下：

port：SLB端口。
targetPort：容器端口。
protocol：网络协议。支持TCP、HTTP和HTTPS。
httpsCertId：SSL证书。仅限选择HTTPS时需配置SSL证书
parameters.name: intranet

parameters.help_zh: 使用指定的已购买的公网SLB，支持非共享型实例
parameters.name: internet_slb_id

parameters.help_zh: 使用指定的已购买的私网SLB，支持非共享型实例
parameters.name: intranet_slb_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of an Internet-facing SLB instance. The following billing methods are supported:

PayBySpec: Pay-by-specification.
PayByCLCU: Pay-by-CLCU
parameters.help_zh:
公网负载均衡的计费方式。支持以下两种计费方式：

PayBySpec：表示按规格计费。
PayByCLCU：表示按使用量计费
parameters.name: internet_slb_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of an Internal-facing SLB instance. The following billing methods are supported:

PayBySpec: Pay-by-specification.
PayByCLCU: Pay-by-CLCU
parameters.help_zh:
内网负载均衡的计费方式。支持以下两种计费方式：

PayBySpec：表示按规格计费。
PayByCLCU：表示按使用量计费
parameters.name: intranet_slb_charge_type

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: indicates that the request was successful.
3xx: indicates that the request was redirected.
4xx: indicates that the request was invalid.
5xx: indicates that a server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change order. It can be used to query the task status
ChangeOrderId.description_zh: 返回的发布单ID，用于查询任务执行状态

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned when the request succeeds.
The ErrorCode parameter is returned when the request fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the SLB instance was successfully associated with the application. Valid values:

true: The SLB instance was successfully associated with the application.
false: The SLB instance could not be associated with the application
Success.description_zh:
绑定SLB是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：绑定成功。
false：绑定失败

TraceId.description_en: The ID of the trace. It can be used to query the details of a request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，可用于精确查询调用信息
